name: delta-stale-removals-give-up-waiting-after-30-seconds
description: A stale removal waiting for a type the Envoy may never ask for gives up after 30 seconds from the stream's first request. With no timer, it goes on the first request after that.

expect.comment: stale waits for LDS, which this Envoy never asks for

steps.comment: Nothing happens until a request or an update
